finalPrompt: Create one original unofficial fan-made full-body static game plate of the licensed 2020 Alpha Predator design. Use a strict three-quarter side profile facing right on a pure opaque #00FF00 background. Preserve tall classic Yautja proportions, pale ashen mottled skin, long ashen-black dreadlocks, primitive bone-and-bronze armor, the sculpted skull/bone biomask with tusk-like projections, attached trophies and the signature curved sickle. The sickle must sit in one clear closed grip and the free hand must remain visible and anatomically coherent. Keep the entire character, hands, dreadlocks, weapon and feet inside the portrait frame with padding. No floor, shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI, watermark, collage, extra limbs, malformed or fused fingers, floating gear, generic sword, katana, axe, combistick, checkerboard or fake transparency.
